pages.name: French: Burn, 6.Bxf6 gxf6 7.Nf3 b6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had the b7-bishop pressing an e4-pawn (it is a knight); plan 4 called e5 a light square. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: French: Burn, 6.Bxf6 gxf6 7.Nf3 f5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Bh3 through Black's own e6-pawn; plan 2 called e5 a light square; overview called f5 and e6 a central pawn mass and missed that the knight is attacked. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: French: Steinitz, Boleslavsky, 7...cxd4 8.Nxd4 Qb6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Qd2 'to defend d4' read as a pawn move and missed the ...Qxb2 Rb1 gambit. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plans 3-4.

pages.name: French Defense: MacCutcheon Variation, Advance Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...g5 as a standard follow-up and missed the main line (...h6, Bd2, ...Bxc3, ...Ne4); plan 1 had a3 against the b4-bishop after e5. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French Defense: MacCutcheon Variation, Dr. Olland Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 named d2 and e3 as moves; plan 1 had a3 'solidifying d4'. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: French Defense: MacCutcheon Variation, Janowski Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had c3 with the knight on c3. Rewrote plan 1 (first rewrite said Nge2 attacks the e4-knight, reviewer rejected, reworded and re-accepted); British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: French Defense: MacCutcheon Variation, Tartakower Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had an a3-b4 advance onto the b4-bishop. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in overview and plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: French: MacCutcheon, 8.Qg4 Kf8
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the king to e7 as a move and the overview said Kf8 takes the king off the g-file. Rewrote overview and plan 4; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: French: MacCutcheon, 8.Qg4 Kf8 9.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 4 had a d7-b6-c4 knight route from b8 and an open b-file for Black (it is half-open for White). Rewrote plan 4. A rewrite of the overview and plan 2 built on 9...Nxc3 was rejected (the d2-bishop guards c3), so both were kept, plan 2 with British spelling.

pages.name: French Defense: Classical Variation, Vistaneckis Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Bxg8 with no piece on g8 to take. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in plan 1.
